description: Source code for the ReportingDeliveryAgent implementation in Chromium, handling report serialization, delivery, and upload management within the net reporting subsystem.

classes.name: Delivery
classes.description: Represents a batch of reports to be uploaded to a specific endpoint, managing report addition and outcome processing.

classes.name: ReportingDeliveryAgentImpl
classes.description: Implements the ReportingDeliveryAgent interface, managing report delivery, scheduling, and upload processes.

methods.name: SerializeReports
methods.description: Serializes a list of reports into a JSON string for upload.

methods.name: RecordReportingUploadHeaderType
methods.description: Records the type of upload header used for reporting metrics.

methods.name: SendReportsForSource
methods.description: Initiates sending reports associated with a specific reporting source.

methods.name: OnReportsUpdated
methods.description: Callback triggered when reports are updated in the cache, potentially triggering report sending.

methods.name: DoSendReports
methods.description: Prepares and initiates the process of sending a batch of reports.

methods.name: OnSendPermissionsChecked
methods.description: Callback after checking if reports can be sent to their origins, organizing reports into deliveries.

methods.name: OnUploadComplete
methods.description: Handles the completion of an upload, updating cache and endpoint states based on success or failure.
